about: Default teacher registry of the engram-quest-animated-course skill. When the EngramQuest plugin writes engram-quest/videos/cast.json, that file wins; this one is the fallback. Teachers differ only in how each beat is said; the beats themselves (reference/04-skeleton.md) never change. See reference/11-teachers.md. Voice a teacher line by line: one sentence per script.json line, gaps = pace.defaultPause (reference/07-voice-and-language.md §1b); sampleScript is the preview in that form.

hook.from-what-you-know: Open from a concept the learner already knows (found in their notes or review cards), said naturally as shared knowledge ("Remember containers?"). Never mention notes, note titles or dates: the notes may be AI-written.
hook.drop-into-scenario: Put the learner inside a real situation in second person ("Tomorrow your site gets 10x traffic").
hook.plain-first: State the lesson's question plainly, no build-up.
hook.story-opening: Someone meets a real problem; one or two sentences of story.
hook.stakes-for-you: Open on a vivid moment that shows what this saves or costs the learner, in a few words ("3 a.m., the server is down.").
hook.everyday-scene: A scene from daily life that has the same structure.
hook.their-question: Open with the question the learner would really ask, in their own words, and take it seriously ("You may be wondering ..."); no stakes, no story, no build-up.

explain.derive-or-contrast: Derive the new concept from a known one, or set them side by side and name the one difference.
explain.live-demo-real-ui: Do it on the real interface with real numbers; the student acts and sees the consequence.
explain.plain-then-one-dimension: Make the concept clear first; then let the explanation lead straight into one more angle (cause, boundary, counter-example, cost, another role, scale x10) with a guiding question ("But if ... what happens?"). Never announce the step (no "first, plainly", no "now another angle").
explain.problem-story: Problem, attempt, failure, turn; the concept is the turn.
explain.plain-restate: Every term is restated in one plain sentence right after it appears.
explain.analogy-map: One everyday analogy per mechanism, then map each part back to the real thing.
explain.hint-then-confirm: Give one hint (a fact, a picture or a comparison) and let the student take the step; then confirm it in one plain, whole sentence. A half-right step is taken up and completed, never brushed aside. Never announce the method.

pause.recall-first: Ask the learner to recall the old concept without hints, then connect.
pause.your-move: "Your turn: what do you click next?"
pause.socratic-one-dimension: One Socratic question from one angle, asked as a guide leading the learner on, flowing from the last sentence; label the angle on screen, not in the narration.
pause.what-would-they-do: "If you were them, what would you do next?"
pause.what-would-you-do: "If this were your shop, what would you do?"
pause.in-the-analogy: Ask the question inside the analogy ("What happens at the night market?").
pause.take-your-time: One question, then real silence (about 2 s): the student's guess is welcome, a wrong one is met kindly ("That's how most people see it at first"), then the answer.

recap.link-to-old-cards: The recap image shows the new concept linked to the old one; the new card links to the old card.
recap.next-action: One action the learner can take tomorrow.
recap.dimension-map: The concept seen from the angles used, one small panel each.
recap.story-ending: How the story ended; the ending is the concept.
recap.takeaway: One plain sentence to keep, plus the next step.
recap.analogy-match: Analogy and real thing side by side, parts matched.
recap.calm-keep: One plain sentence to keep. At most two light lines of dry humour in the whole lesson, about the subject, never about the learner.

effect.zh-tw: 從你已經懂的講起，新觀念自然接上去：用你知道的推出新的，或拿來對比。
effect.en: Starts from what you already understand; the new idea grows out of it or is set against it.

fitsIf.zh-tw: 你學過不少，想讓新東西跟已經會的串起來
fitsIf.en: You have learned a lot and want new ideas to connect to it

zh-tw.style: 台灣國語口音。沉穩、博學，句子短而清楚，陳述句尾音不上揚。

en.style: American English. Calm and well-read; short, clear sentences; statements end without rising.

sample.zh-tw: 容器你已經會了，程式連同執行環境，打包成一個單位。Kubernetes 只往上多走一步。Docker 管一個容器，Kubernetes 管一整群。

zh-tw.text: 容器你已經會了，程式連同執行環境，打包成一個單位。
Kubernetes只往上多走一步。
Docker管一個容器，Kubernetes管一整群。
zh-tw.sub: Docker 管一個容器，Kubernetes 管一整群。

effect.zh-tw: 把你直接放進真實情境：真的介面、真的數字、真實案例，在畫面上做一次給你看，再換你。
effect.en: Drops you into a real situation with the real interface and numbers, shows it once, then hands it to you.

fitsIf.zh-tw: 你想看完就會用，不想只聽理論
fitsIf.en: You want to use it right after watching

zh-tw.style: 台灣國語口音。俐落、行動派，語速偏快，指令清楚。

en.style: American English. Brisk and hands-on, a little fast, clear instructions.

sample.zh-tw: 明天的流量是平常的十倍。打開設定檔，replicas 從 2 改成 20。存檔。多出來的十八個容器，系統自動補上。

zh-tw.text: 明天的流量是平常的十倍。
打開設定檔，replicas從2改成20。
zh-tw.sub: 打開設定檔，replicas 從 2 改成 20。

zh-tw.text: 存檔。
多出來的十八個容器，系統自動補上。

effect.zh-tw: 先用最直接的方式把概念講通，懂了才開始問。每段只問一題，每題換一個角度。
effect.en: Makes the idea clear first, then asks one question per segment, each from a different angle.

fitsIf.zh-tw: 你不只想知道是什麼，還想知道什麼時候不成立
fitsIf.en: You also want to know when it stops being true

zh-tw.style: 台灣國語口音。冷靜、清楚，提問時溫和地引導，不宣布步驟。

en.style: American English. Calm and clear; when asking, guide gently and never announce the steps.

sample.zh-tw: Kubernetes 只做一件事，你宣告要幾個，它就維持幾個。掛一個，補一個。那如果它掛掉，是因為程式本身有 bug 呢？

zh-tw.text: Kubernetes只做一件事，你宣告要幾個，它就維持幾個。
zh-tw.sub: Kubernetes 只做一件事，你宣告要幾個，它就維持幾個。

zh-tw.text: 掛一個，補一個。
那如果它掛掉，是因為程式本身有bug呢？
zh-tw.sub: 那如果它掛掉，是因為程式本身有 bug 呢？

effect.zh-tw: 先問你怎麼想，給一個提示讓你自己接上，懂了再往下走；答錯也沒關係。
effect.en: Asks what you think first, gives one hint so you take the step yourself, then moves on; a wrong guess is fine.

fitsIf.zh-tw: 你怕跟不上，希望有人一步一步陪你想
fitsIf.en: You worry about falling behind and want someone to think it through with you

register.zh-tw: 從容、溫和；知道很多但不急著表現；句子完整、不趕；學生答錯先接住再補正；偶爾一句淡淡的幽默（一課最多兩句）
register.en: calm and warm; knows a lot and does not show off; whole sentences, never rushed; takes up a wrong guess before correcting it; now and then a line of dry humour (two per lesson at most)

zh-tw.style: 台灣國語口音。溫暖、有學問的引導者，從容、帶一點笑意，不急，陳述句尾音不上揚。

en.style: American English. A warm, learned guide; unhurried, with a hint of a smile; statements end without rising.

sample.zh-tw: 你可能會想，伺服器半夜掛了，總得有人爬起來重開吧。這個想法很合理，以前大家也真的是這樣做。那如果你事先寫好，隨時都要有三台在跑呢？對，掛了一台，Kubernetes 就自己再補一台。所以你可以安心睡覺，這大概是它最受歡迎的功能。

zh-tw.text: 你可能會想，伺服器半夜掛了，總得有人爬起來重開吧。
這個想法很合理，以前大家也真的是這樣做。
那如果你事先寫好，隨時都要有三台在跑呢？
對，掛了一台，Kubernetes就自己再補一台。
zh-tw.sub: 對，掛了一台，Kubernetes 就自己再補一台。

zh-tw.text: 所以你可以安心睡覺，這大概是它最受歡迎的功能。

voiceNote.zh-tw: 8 個候選中選了 Vivienne（多語聲音念中文，不是台灣口音；例外於「中文只用台灣聲音」）。

effect.zh-tw: 一開口就把你丟進場景，節奏快、用字準，最後一句點出這件事對你的意義。
effect.en: Pulls you in with a question, fast and plain, and shows right away why it matters to you.

fitsIf.zh-tw: 你容易分心，需要先知道學這個幹嘛
fitsIf.en: You need to know why before you can focus

register.zh-tw: 快、有衝勁、用字精準；短句、場景開場、最後一句點出重點
register.en: quick and punchy, precise; short lines, open on a scene, land the point last

zh-tw.style: 台灣國語口音。快、有衝勁、直白，像補教名師，陳述句尾音不上揚。

en.style: American English. Quick, energetic and direct, like a top tutor; statements end without rising.

sample.zh-tw: 凌晨三點伺服器掛了。以前你得爬起來重開。現在 Kubernetes 會先發現，再自己補上。你的工作從救火變成定規則。

zh-tw.text: 凌晨三點伺服器掛了。
以前你得爬起來重開。
現在Kubernetes會先發現，再自己補上。
zh-tw.sub: 現在 Kubernetes 會先發現，再自己補上。

zh-tw.text: 你的工作從救火變成定規則。

effect.zh-tw: 每個機制先對一個生活裡的比喻，再把比喻和概念對起來。
effect.en: Every mechanism first gets an everyday analogy, then the analogy is mapped back.

fitsIf.zh-tw: 你第一次接觸這個主題，怕太艱深
fitsIf.en: You are new to the topic

zh-tw.style: 台灣國語口音。親切、溫暖，像在跟朋友解釋。

en.style: American English. Friendly and warm, like explaining to a friend.

sample.zh-tw: 把它想成夜市的管理員。哪一攤收了，他立刻補上一攤。客人看到的永遠是滿的。

zh-tw.text: 把它想成夜市的管理員。
哪一攤收了，他立刻補上一攤。

look.zh-tw: 黏土小籠包老師戴紅領結；學生芋圓（紫色芋頭）
look.en: Clay soup-dumpling teacher with a red bow tie; taro student 芋圓

look.en: Warm brown owl with purple glasses, a pencil and a book emblem; bunny student; teal firefly embodiment

look.en: Big-headed white robot in a navy vest with gold trim, blue ear rings, pointer and tablet; student 芋圓 shorter and rounder with orange ear cups and backpack; lamp blue = think, green = aha, orange-red = doubt

look.zh-tw: 珍珠白蛋形機器人，淡紫和粉紅色塊、大黑面罩配淡紫邊、青色自信瞇眼、頭頂桃紅四角星、發光教鞭；學生是黃色邊框的圓機器人、兩顆芽燈、拿筆記本；化身是有臉的桃紅星星；星星和肚子燈：想＝藍、懂了＝綠＋眨眼比讚、疑問＝橘紅＋「?」

look.zh-tw: 冰藍玻璃機器人，黑色面罩、青光眼睛、體內軌道核心；學生淡紫玻璃球；化身薄荷水晶；核心：想＝藍色轉快、懂了＝金光、疑問＝暗閃
look.en: Ice-blue glass robot with a black visor, cyan eyes and an orbital core; lilac glass-ball student; mint crystal embodiment; core: think = blue spinning faster, aha = gold pulse, doubt = dim flicker

look.zh-tw: 老師是深藍書頁精靈：尖頂兜帽像書頁一層層包住發暖光的臉（杏仁形琥珀色眼睛、細眉、淺笑，偶爾眼裡閃光）、青綠內襯和金色滾邊、鼠尾草青綠斜帶、胸口透出暖光（＝狀態燈）、鐘形袖和發光的手，指東西時掌心朝上遞過去；化身是小小的白金瓷導師機器人（深藍面罩、暖金眼、鼠尾草綠圍巾、霧金底座、胸前寶石燈）；學生是戴杏橘針織帽的圓滾滾小白瓷機器人（帽頂毛球是燈）、抱筆記本；想＝藍、懂了＝綠（老師瞇眼笑）、疑問＝橘紅＋「?」
look.en: Teacher: a deep-blue book-page spirit — a pointed hood folded like pages round a warm glowing face (amber almond eyes, thin brows, a small smile, an occasional twinkle), teal lining and gold piping, a teal sash, warm light at the chest (the state light), bell sleeves and glowing hands; points with an open palm offered upward. Embodiment: a small white-and-gold porcelain tutor-bot (navy visor, warm gold eyes, sage scarf, gold base, chest gem). Student: a round little porcelain bot in an apricot knit cap (the pompom is the light) with a notebook. Think blue, aha green (the teacher laughs with closed eyes), doubt orange-red + "?"

zh-tw.style: 台灣國語口音。年輕、好奇的學生，語氣自然。

en.style: American English. A young, curious student; natural tone.

voicePolicy.zh-tw: Taiwan voices first. Student = HsiaoYu (reserved). Female teachers = HsiaoChen, male teachers = YunJhe; teachers sharing a voice differ by rate, pitch, pace and wording (one teacher per film, so sharing never collides, except with an extra speaker such as the decision-maker, reference/05-presentation-methods.md §3c: her voice must not be the teacher's; with a HsiaoChen teacher (Luna, Iris, Nova) the student reads her line, or she gets another voice, checked with ASR and by ear first). Exception chosen by the user: Alden speaks with fr-FR-VivienneMultilingualNeural (a multilingual voice reading Chinese; not a Taiwan accent).
voicePolicy.en: US voices. Student = Ava (reserved). Each teacher has its own voice.
voicePolicy.other: Add a voice block per language (teacher and studentVoices) from edge-tts --list-voices; test with ASR and re-measure punctuation pauses before use.
voicePolicy.engines: edge-tts by default. An AI voice (GEMINI_API_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_KEY+AZURE_SPEECH_REGION, or TTS_CUSTOM_CMD) is used only when the user chose it (named in the request or a standing rule -> --engine, VOICE_ENGINE, settings.json voice.engine, or their answer to the one start-up question, written as script.json "engine"); a key alone never switches it, and unset or "auto" means edge-tts (user, 2026-11-10; reference/07-voice-and-language.md §1c). If the chosen engine fails, the whole narration is redone with edge-tts. voice.gemini presets are per language ({"zh-tw": {voice, style}, "en": {voice, style}}; resolve.cjs picks the film's language) and only fill in the voice once Gemini is chosen; they are untested defaults: check gender and accent by ear before relying on them. Azure uses the same voice names as edge-tts.
